gates.summary: Enable GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting before public beta.
gates.evidence_required: Automated/local rehearsal runs `./scripts/release-security-pvr.sh --allow-unavailable` and writes generated evidence under `state/release-evidence/`, but this gate remains open until a repo owner/admin enables GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting in GitHub repository settings. commands: Go to Settings > Code security and analysis > Private vulnerability reporting, or repository Settings > Advanced Security
Confirm SECURITY.md points reporters at the active GitHub reporting path
evidence: Generated evidence summary path under state/release-evidence from scripts/release-security-pvr.sh
GitHub docs/settings path used to enable Private vulnerability reporting
Screenshot/reference from repository Settings > Advanced Security showing Private vulnerability reporting enabled
